doc.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Arriving in 1955 with a friend; abandoning the Manhattan School audition
summary: Walton recalls the YMCA overnight on the drive with a friend named Milton, then planning to enroll at Manhattan School of Music but fleeing the waiting room because he was not ready.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah, that's when I made the drive from Denver to uh, New York.
Oh man, I can't remember my friend's name. Jesus Christ. I'll have to say Milton something. Hmm Hm-Hm.
No. No, just a friend who had been in New York before. He was ravin' about it and tryin' to get back. He loved it.
He was tryin' to get back and you're tryin' to get there.
Yeah. So we had, you know, a mutual uh, uh goal. We actually stopped off and spent the night in some city at some YMCA, you know. The budget allowed all that. I just can't believe it.
What were you, in going to New York, what were you going to? Were you …
Did you have somebody's phone number? Were you gonna check up with somebody?

I had a couple of phone numbers and uh, Ed Thigpen, uh, comes to mind who had encour… anybody who had come to this club, I tried to get their number. But uh, you could find a lot of 'em who I had met there uh, playing at different places, jam sessions and things, so I had uh, uh, a plan in mind to uh, start, uh, to enroll in Manhattan School of Music. But realistically, I wasn't quite ready because I hadn't worked uh, diligently enough on certain pieces, you know, that were required. Not that there was a list of pieces that you needed to play, but uh, you needed to play a complete work of something, and I wasn't ready. And you could hear the other, uh, applicants while you were waiting and oh, I said "No, I gotta get outta here." And that was the end of that idea.
Oh yeah, I went in there in the, in the, in the, like in the waiting room at the dentist or doctor.
Oh, this is gonna hurt too much.
I’m not gonna have this root canal today.
